rationale: The reporter names a concrete regression point (worked before, changed in 0.12.1) for dependency-group resolution when syncing a workspace member that has a dev group of the same name as the workspace root. Playbook rule 2 treats a release-named regression as a strong bug signal, and the report is specific enough to reproduce (root and member each declare dev, run sync from the member directory). The docs page for workspaces (docs/concepts/projects/workspaces.md) does not state whether root dependency groups merge into members, so the contract is not documented, which lowers confidence to medium. Nothing points outside uv, and the report does not hinge on an enforcement change, so rule 2's exception does not apply. search_issues for the override/additive symptom returned no matching earlier issues, and the only search hit (#8148, cyclic dev deps) is a different problem, so it is not listed. The search tool returned no duplicates; this is not verified against the full tracker.
